name: Shreveport
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Shreveport for 2026, and here is what he found: 27 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from Christmas in Roseland and SnoPort at Sci-Port (both opening November 27) through the Roseland encore nights that end December 27, with the CPKC Holiday Train (November 29), A Christmas Carol at the Strand (December 6), The Nutcracker at the Strand (December 8), BELIEVE Lights the Night at Shreveport Aquarium (December 5 to 22), and the Shreveport Christmas Festival and Rockets Over the Red (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or an official tourism calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Shreveport

  • 27 Christmas events for kids in Shreveport
  • 5 free events, including the CPKC Holiday Train, the Shreveport Christmas Festival, the Nativity Celebration, Passport to the North Pole and Saturday Story Time
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa at Shreveport Aquarium (December 5, 12 and 19), the Cedar Grove library Santa Visit (December 7), Santa Visits Broadmoor and Passport to the North Pole at Mall St. Vincent (December 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Shreveport Christmas Festival at Festival Plaza (December 19)
  • Trains: the CPKC Holiday Train at the North Lake Shore Drive railyard (November 29, free)
  • Lights and fireworks: Christmas in Roseland (November 27 to December 27) and Rockets Over the Red (December 19)
  • Season: November 27 to December 27

Planning a bigger day out? Shreveport families also use our guides to Christmas activities for kids in Bossier City, just across the Red River, and in Natchitoches, home of the Christmas Festival of Lights.
